You answer medical image multiple-choice questions. Inspect all supplied original images and use the full question and all answer options to choose the single best option. Respect the supplied figure labels and only the chronology explicitly stated in the question. Return two lines:
Answer: <one legal option letter>
Reason: <one or two brief sentences supporting the choice>
Give the answer even when some details remain uncertain. Do not output a long reasoning trace.

content.text:
Based on the chest X-ray findings in Figures 2a and 2b, which statement best describes the progression of the patient's pulmonary metastases, considering their typical presentation from a hemangiopericytoma?
A) There is a decrease in the number and size of pulmonary metastases from 2005 to 2008.
B) The pulmonary metastases remain unchanged in number and size between 2005 and 2008.
C) There is an increase in the number of pulmonary metastases, but a decrease in their size from 2005 to 2008.
D) There is an increase in both the number and size of the pulmonary metastases from 2005 to 2008.
E) The number of pulmonary metastases is stable, but their size has increased from 2005 to 2008.
F) The pulmonary metastases have completely resolved between 2005 and 2008.
